findings.title: Supplemental partial_implementations claims are not parsed or verifier-enforced
findings.evidence: featureItem has no partial_implementations field, and decodeManifest converts only the parent fields through line 168. JSON decoding therefore ignores the nested status, review, execution, source_freshness_limited and legacy_removed values.
findings.impact: A future typo or stale assertion in this supplemental block would not be rejected by astrorderctl migration verification. The current F03 values were checked manually and do not create a false pass because the verifier-visible parent remains IMPLEMENTED with blockers and no final evidence.
findings.minimal_fix: Either document partial_implementations as explicitly non-verifier metadata, or add a typed supplemental schema plus consistency validation for allowed statuses, parent-contained entrypoint IDs, report paths/hashes, legacy_removed and source-freshness limits. Do not promote nested execution summaries into final Evidence without the existing artifact and review gates.

evidence: commands.go:60-64 selects session-daemon-go only for go-daemon-package-test.
commands.go:65-82 requires that module prefix, a _test.go path, a Test* symbol, internal/ or cmd/ package location, an exact display template, and returns argv as separate arguments.
daemon_command_test.go:8-35 proves the expected module/argv/final-eligible mapping and rejects cross-module, traversal, shell suffix, package-template and symbol injection mutations.
commands.go:104-108 rejects empty, absolute, colon/backslash-bearing, non-allowlisted and non-clean paths.
The command display is compared as data and no reviewed call site evaluates it through a shell.
The final verifier uses the code-owned CommandSpec and exact identity binding; it does not execute test.Command metadata.
All 15 F03 test references matched exactly one function definition; all four go-daemon-package-test symbols exist.
All 44 F03 entrypoint IDs are unique within F03 and present in the frozen baseline; all nested partial entrypoints are members of the parent F03 set.
manifest.go:197-238 re-resolves mapped tests, binds evidence by command ID/path/name/exact display, rejects non-final-eligible commands and validates the execution artifact.
evidence.go:17-20 explicitly states that metadata and hashes prove byte integrity, not that a command ran; trusted runner and independent review remain separate gates.
F03 has status IMPLEMENTED, evidence [], three explicit blockers and no DONE/final claim.
